parent.a: An internet connection is required for live tracking and notifications; offline events sync later once you reconnect.

parent.q: Can I add more than one child?
parent.a: Yes, add every child to your profile and follow each trip separately.
Use the WhatsApp button or email support@busaty.org.

parent.q: How do I track the bus?
parent.a: Open the in-app map to see live location and ETA.

parent.q: I’m not receiving notifications. What should I do?
parent.a: Enable notifications and location permissions, then update the app.

parent.q: How do I add or edit the home address?
parent.a: Go to the student profile → Addresses → Add/Edit.

supervisor.a: On the trip screen, confirm each student’s boarding/drop-off in order.

supervisor.q: A student is absent — what happens?
supervisor.a: They are marked absent automatically and a guardian alert can be sent if needed.

supervisor.q: How do I assign students to buses?
supervisor.a: From the dashboard: import students, then assign them to lines/buses.
Yes — trip, delay, and usage indicators are available in the dashboard.

school.q: How do I assign attendants and drivers?
school.a: Use the control panel to choose each line and select the attendant/driver for every bus.

school.q: How do I notify families during emergencies?
school.a: Send a broadcast via the built-in alerts or WhatsApp button with the latest status.
